# A Generative Slice

> A Generative Slice is an elite AI products laboratory and bespoke web systems engineering studio headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded and directed by Mohammed Hussain, the studio builds high-agency agentic AI automation, RAG pipelines, enterprise trading ERPs, real-time 3D spatial web apps, and modern high-conversion web platforms.

## Slice Product Suite (ProdX) — Open-Core Architecture
Our developer-facing automation engines follow an open-core model with publicly auditable GitHub repositories for complete client transparency, while enterprise cloud hosting, custom integrations, and managed infrastructure are delivered through private commercial SLA retainers.
Explore our dedicated products at https://agenerativeslice.com/products :
- [Slice3D](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): Hardware-accelerated browser-based 3D spatial product visualizer and interactive showcase without plugins or apps.
- [SliceLeads](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): Autonomous local business lead engine discovering verified B2B prospects and generating personalized omnichannel pitches.
- [SliceMail](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): High-deliverability intelligent cold email pitching and client outreach engine handling 400+ targeted emails/day with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC compliance.
- [SliceInbox](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): Self-hosted mailbox Chief of Staff AI agent that automatically triages client inquiries and routes VIP priorities.
- [SlicePPT](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): Instant executive presentation and 16:9 pitch deck generator from raw business notes and spreadsheets.
- [SliceDAM](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): Enterprise digital asset and document vault automating NDAs, SOW contracts, invoices, and system requirement specifications.
- [SliceClass](https://agenerativeslice.com/products): Next-gen online learning academy and video streaming studio featuring phone OTP authentication and sub-second video delivery.

## Key Client Case Studies & Production Deliverables
Explore our real client work at https://agenerativeslice.com/projects :
- **Sree Ambal Catering** (Hospitality & F&B): Offline-first PWA banquet inventory and multilingual Tamil/English catalog engine solving remote venue stock coordination.
- **Rose Chemicals** (Industrial & Retail): B2B chemical distribution portal integrated with Sarvam AI conversational WhatsApp ordering.
- **Project Mald** (Enterprise Trading): Complete Trading Company ERP with neural vision AI OCR invoice reading, multi-currency FX (MVR/USD/EUR), and automated credit recovery.
- **NAS Design & Construction** (Architecture & Real Estate): High-end 3D architectural real estate showcase with GSAP interactive spatial flows.
- **NAS Internationals** (Luxury Travel): Global travel booking and automated visa verification engine built on Supabase.
- **Velvet Trunk** (Luxury E-Commerce & Retail): Real-time interactive SVG exhibition stall reservation and vendor invoicing system.
- **Your Huckleberry** (Hospitality & F&B): Boutique artisanal bakery web experience with interactive cake customizer.
- **Arusuvai Arasu** (Hospitality & F&B): 60-second automated banquet quotation and dynamic PDF proposal generator.

## Technical Capabilities & Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite 7, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, GSAP.
- **Backend & AI**: Python, FastAPI, Gemini AI, LangChain, Ollama, Supabase, PostgreSQL.
- **Infrastructure & Deliverability**: Nginx, Cloud VPS, Zoho Business Mail, Web3Forms API, Razorpay, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication.

## AI & Humans — Manifesto & Free Student Workshops
- [AI Is Not Your Competition](https://agenerativeslice.com/ai-for-humans/): The founder's manifesto on AI as a tool for human advancement, not replacement — "AI will not take your job. A person who knows how to use AI will take the job of a person who doesn't." Includes the interactive Reframe Machine and the founder's exact learning/building loops.
- **Free workshops for freshers & college students** (Chennai in-person + live online, Tamil/English): AI from absolute zero, the learning loop (explain → quiz → teach back), the problem-solving loop (draft → test → verify), the psychology of confidence, and one shipped portfolio project. ₹0 forever, no sales pitch, no experience needed. Register via WhatsApp +91 78128 91494; colleges can host on campus via the contact page.
